subject: maths
question: A software company has only 3 divisions that have 20, 30 and 40 employees, respectively. If the working percentage of this during a weekend were 20%, 30% and 40%, respectively, then the working percentage of the entire company during that weekend was approximately:
solution:
**Calculations:**

According to the question,

People working on weekend = 20% of 20 + 30% of 30 + 40% of 40

⇒ 0.20 &am
